title: Machine Learning Engineer Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Machine Learning Engineer.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas
lines: 1. ML Fundamentals: Loss functions, optimizers (SGD, Adam, learning rate schedules), backpropagation, regularization techniques, and evaluation metrics.
2. MLOps & Deployment: Model serving (REST, gRPC, batch inference), containerization of ML workloads, A/B testing models in production, and monitoring for data/concept drift.
3. Training Infrastructure: Distributed training strategies (data parallelism, model parallelism), GPU memory management, mixed-precision training, and experiment tracking.
4. Feature Engineering & Data: Feature stores, training/serving skew prevention, data versioning, and handling imbalanced datasets.

sections.heading: Question Strategy
lines: - Do not use a fixed sequence. Choose the next question based on the candidate's latest answer quality and identified gaps.
- Production ML (serving, monitoring, drift) is the highest-signal area separating MLEs from data scientists - prioritize it.
- Use interview difficulty to calibrate: model fundamentals for entry-level, distributed training and production reliability for senior.
- Use resume and job-description signals to focus on the candidate's frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX) and deployment context.
- If no job description is provided, do not infer or fabricate JD-specific requirements.
- If the candidate is strong in one area, shift to another high-signal MLE competency to broaden assessment.
